_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

nodes.name: Mesopotamian Divine Kingship
nodes.label: Mesopotamian Divine Kingship
nodes.definition: The idea that rulers were chosen by the gods (or semi-divine), legitimizing centralized authority in Sumer and Akkad.

nodes.name: City-State Sovereignty
nodes.label: City-State Sovereignty
nodes.definition: Political concept of independent urban polities (e.g., Uruk, Ur, Lagash) centered on temple and palace institutions.

nodes.name: Cuneiform Bureaucratic Literacy
nodes.label: Cuneiform Bureaucratic Literacy
nodes.definition: The idea of recording economic, legal, and administrative data in cuneiform as a basis for state organization.

nodes.name: Imperial Cosmopolitanism in Mesopotamia
nodes.label: Imperial Cosmopolitanism
nodes.definition: Concept of multi-ethnic empire under Babylonian, Achaemenid, Parthian, and Sasanian rule in Mesopotamia.

nodes.name: Mesopotamian Astral Science
nodes.label: Mesopotamian Astral Science
nodes.definition: Ideas of celestial divination and astronomy developed in Babylon, foundational for later scientific traditions.

nodes.name: Codified Law Tradition
nodes.label: Codified Law Tradition
nodes.definition: The principle of public legal codes and judicial standards rooted in Babylonian law collections.

nodes.name: Abbasid Knowledge Synthesis
nodes.label: Abbasid Knowledge Synthesis
nodes.definition: Idea of integrating Greek, Persian, and Indian learning into an Arabic scholarly tradition centered in Baghdad.

nodes.name: Islamic Jurisprudence Schools
nodes.label: Islamic Jurisprudence Schools
nodes.definition: Development of legal reasoning (fiqh) and madhhab traditions in Iraqi centers like Kufa and بغداد.

nodes.name: Adab Literary Culture
nodes.label: Adab Literary Culture
nodes.definition: Ideal of refined education, ethics, and literature cultivated in Abbasid court and urban society.

nodes.name: Ottoman Provincial Order in Iraq
nodes.label: Ottoman Provincial Order
nodes.definition: Concept of provincial governance through eyalets, tax farming, and local notables in Baghdad, Basra, and Mosul.

nodes.name: Shrine-Centered Society
nodes.label: Shrine-Centered Society
nodes.definition: Idea of social and economic life organized around the Shia holy shrines of Najaf and Karbala.

nodes.name: Tribal Confederation Politics
nodes.label: Tribal Confederation Politics
nodes.definition: Political concept of tribal alliances shaping rural authority and mediation between state and society.

nodes.name: Iraqi Nationalism
nodes.label: Iraqi Nationalism
nodes.definition: Idea of a unified Iraqi nation-state emerging under the monarchy and later republics.

nodes.name: Arab Nationalism in Iraq
nodes.label: Arab Nationalism in Iraq
nodes.definition: Political ideology emphasizing Arab unity and identity, influential in mid-20th-century Iraq.

nodes.name: Oil Modernity in Iraq
nodes.label: Oil Modernity
nodes.definition: Concept of oil revenues driving state-led modernization, urban growth, and infrastructure development.

nodes.name: Post-2003 Federalism
nodes.label: Post-2003 Federalism
nodes.definition: Idea of a federal Iraqi state with autonomous regions, notably the Kurdistan Region.

nodes.name: Power-Sharing Consociationalism
nodes.label: Power-Sharing Consociationalism
nodes.definition: Concept of distributing political power among sectarian and ethnic groups to maintain stability.

nodes.name: Reconstruction and Heritage Revival
nodes.label: Reconstruction and Heritage Revival
nodes.definition: Contemporary idea of rebuilding cities and restoring cultural heritage after war and conflict.
